name: Cereals
description: Primary carbohydrate staples with high agronomic response to balanced N-P-K and biostimulant tillering promoters.

name: Millets (Nutri-Cereals)
description: Climate-resilient, drought-tolerant C4 grasses requiring minimal irrigation and thriving in dryland semi-arid ecosystems.

name: Pulses & Legumes
description: Atmospheric nitrogen-fixing grain legumes critical for restoring soil fertility and protein security.

name: Oilseeds
description: High-value commercial energy crops sensitive to moisture stress and responsive to sulphur and foliar biostimulants.

name: Fibre Crops
description: Industrial cash crops requiring intensive boll-retention nutrition and sucking pest management.

name: Sugar Crops
description: Heavy biomass annual crops with substantial potassium, irrigation, and micronutrient demands.

name: Vegetables & Spices
description: High-investment perishable horticulture vulnerable to foliar blights and post-harvest quality dockage.

name: Abiotic Stress Management
description: Drought, heat, flood, and salinity physiological remediation techniques using biostimulants and potassium silicate.

name: Integrated Pest & Disease Management (IPM)
description: Bio-rational pest management, microbial antagonists (Trichoderma, Pseudomonas), and approved statutory CIBRC spray schedules.
